citation: Case report: Rhizomucor pusillus pneumonia in an AML/HSCT patient detected by mNGS, 2022

population.population_description: 56-year-old male with AML post-HSCT, R. pusillus pneumonia

index_test.platform_or_panel: metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS), details in article

reference_standard: Clinical diagnosis with culture confirmation of clinical isolate R. pusillus JY54 (antifungal susceptibility testing)
additional_yield_vs_conventional: mNGS detected R. pusillus; conventional tools slow/less sensitive (qualitative)
therapy_change: Antifungal therapy guided by susceptibility; patient deteriorated and family gave up treatment, discharged
mortality_or_outcomes: Patient deteriorated and was discharged at family decision
quadas2_notes: Single case report; no denominators; not usable for pooled analysis.

evidence_quotes.claim: case report of R. pusillus detected by mNGS
evidence_quotes.quote: Here, we report a case of R. pusillus pneumonia in a haematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) patient, detected by the mNGS method.
With the continuous deterioration of symptoms, the patient's family decided to give up treatment, and the patient was discharged.
